title: The runbook says what to do when Vercel Cron itself stops

verify.note: Fails before the change: no runbook section covers the scheduler itself.

detail: Vercel Cron is the only scheduler for 40 jobs. A scheduler outage looks like many separate job failures. Added a section to the cron runbook: how to recognise it, where to confirm, the manual call order, and why a second scheduler needs idempotent claims first.
